name: g03-surf
prompt:
ENG-G03 (normal and roughness/metallic maps for imported models). Define `ModelModule::surfaceSetFor` (declared in ModelModule.h; read the members it uses there) right after the one-line `VkDescriptorSet ModelModule::textureSetFor(...)` definition, with a blank line before it. It returns model.frag's set 2 for one combination of maps:
1. Signature: `VkDescriptorSet ModelModule::surfaceSetFor(const std::string& albedo, const std::string& normal, const std::string& roughness, const std::string& metallic) {`
2. `const std::string key = albedo + '\n' + normal + '\n' + roughness + '\n' + metallic;` and return the cached set when `m_surfaceSets.find(key)` finds it.
3. `const Texture& white = m_app->defaultWhiteTexture();` then `const Texture* maps[4] = { &white, m_flatNormal.get(), &white, &white };` and `const std::string* paths[4] = { &albedo, &normal, &roughness, &metallic };`. For each i in 0..3 whose path is not empty: `if (const Texture* t = m_app->cachedTexture(*paths[i])) maps[i] = t;`
4. Allocate one set: a `VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo alloc{};` with sType VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO, `alloc.descriptorPool = m_surfacePool;`, `alloc.descriptorSetCount = 1;`, `alloc.pSetLayouts = &m_surfaceLayout;` into `VkDescriptorSet set = VK_NULL_HANDLE;`.
5. If vkAllocateDescriptorSets(m_device, &alloc, &set) is not VK_SUCCESS: `log::get(name())->warn("material set pool full; '{}' drawn with default maps", albedo);` and `set = m_defaultSurface;`
6. Otherwise write all four bindings in one call: `VkDescriptorImageInfo images[4];` and `VkWriteDescriptorSet writes[4]{};`; for uint32_t i in 0..3: `images[i] = { maps[i]->sampler(), maps[i]->imageView(), VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL };` and writes[i] with sType VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, `writes[i].dstSet = set;`, `writes[i].dstBinding = i;`, descriptorCount 1, descriptorType VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, `writes[i].pImageInfo = &images[i];`; then `vkUpdateDescriptorSets(m_device, 4, writes, 0, nullptr);`
7. `m_surfaceSets[key] = set;` and `return set;`
Change nothing else.
